_note: Answers verified by hand against the snapshot BEFORE any run (2026-09-22). Grading: 'name' = expected token appears in the ANSWER line; 'number' = expected value is the FIRST number in the ANSWER line.

topics.brief: chooses the next step of a plan and handles blocked steps — start at Store.nextStep in src/db.mjs
handles usage limits, retries and per-step attempt caps in the orchestrator — scripts/runner.mjs
configures and locates its SQLite database — the Store constructor and defaultDbPath in src/db.mjs
builds and self-tests the Windows exe — scripts/build-exe.mjs
searches and ranks recall and lessons — Store.recall and Store.getLessons in src/db.mjs
defines and enforces the inject-mode agent output contract and the VERIFY gate — scripts/runner-lib.mjs

questions.q: When every remaining step of a plan is blocked, what property name does Store.nextStep put on the object it returns to signal that? Give the exact property name.
When Store.nextStep returns a workable step after skipping blocked ones, what property on the returned step lists the skipped blocked steps? Give the exact property name.
What is the orchestrator runner's default value for --retry-minutes?
What is the orchestrator runner's default value for --max-retries?
What PRAGMA busy_timeout value, in milliseconds, does the Store set on its SQLite connection?
Which environment variable overrides the default plan-ledger database path? Give its exact name.
Which TCP port does the exe build script use to boot-test the freshly built exe?
What byte-marker prefix does the exe build script search the node binary for, to auto-detect the SEA fuse? Give the exact marker text.
What is the default `limit` parameter of Store.recall?
What is the default `limit` parameter of Store.getLessons?
What is runVerify's default timeout, expressed in minutes?
What verdict does parseVerdict return when the agent's output contains no VERDICT line? Give the single word.
